detailed_description: The JSON to XML converter turns pasted JSON into a simple XML string in the browser. It parses the JSON textarea, wraps the result with an XML declaration, converts object keys into element names, converts arrays into repeated item elements, and writes primitive values as text content. Invalid JSON shows an error message, and the generated XML can be copied from the output textarea. The tool is best suited for quick formatting tests with simple JSON structures rather than schema-driven XML generation.
usage_steps: Paste valid JSON into the JSON textarea.
Click Convert to parse the input and generate XML.
Review the XML output or the invalid JSON error message.
Copy the generated XML from the output textarea.
usage_examples: Convert a small JSON object into XML for a quick example.
Turn a simple array into repeated item elements while testing data formats.
Check how nested JSON objects are represented as child XML elements.
Copy generated XML from a pasted JSON sample for a local prototype.
